latest.title: On Miyaoka-Yau Inequalities and Weil-Petersson Metrics
latest.abstract: We use the Kähler-Ricci flow to give alternate proofs of several known Miyaoka-Yau inequalities and slope semi-stabilities, in particular, for the case of compact Kähler manifolds with semi-ample canonical line bundles and K-semistable Fano manifolds. Moreover, when the canonical line bundle is semi-ample, and the Kodaira dimension is $n-1$, we prove the Miyaoka-Yau quantity is equal to the intersection of the Weil-Petersson metric and the Fubini-Study metric on the canonical model. Consequently, equality holds in the Miyaoka-Yau inequality if and only if the pluricanonical map is a holomorphic fibre bundle.
latest.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
latest.workSummary: 用 Kähler–Ricci 流重证若干 Miyaoka–Yau 不等式，并在 Kodaira 维数 n-1 时刻画等号。
latest.breakthrough: 将曲率积分缺陷与正则模型上的纤维几何联系。
latest.limitations: 主结构结论需典范丛半丰沛；重证部分不应包装成全新不等式。 研究结论按摘要级分析；未完成正文方法核验。
